quotes: **Methods** — In this international, multicentre, double-blind, randomised trial, 6 609 adults with CKD at risk of progression were allocated 1∶1 to empagliflozin 10 mg once daily or matching placebo. Key eligibility criteria were an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) between 20 and <45 mL/min/1.73 m² (any albuminuria) or between 45 and <90 mL/min/1.73 m² with a urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (ACR) of at least 200 mg/g. The primary endpoint was a composite of kidney disease progression (onset of end-stage kidney disease, a sustained eGFR below 10 mL/min/1.73 m², a sustained ≥ 40 % decline in eGFR, or renal death) or death from cardiovascular causes.

quotes: ### Conclusion In a CKD population intentionally designed to reflect the breadth of patients encountered in clinical practice — including substantial proportions without diabetes, with markedly reduced eGFR, and with low‑grade albuminuria — empagliflozin 10 mg daily reduced the risk of kidney disease progression or cardiovascular death by 28 % over a median of 2.0 years, with a tolerable safety profile. These data support the use of SGLT2 inhibition as a cornerstone therapy for a wide spectrum of chronic kidney disease. --- ## Source Citation The EMPA-KIDNEY Collaborative Group. Empagliflozin in Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease. *New England Journal of Medicine* 2023; **388**: 117–127.

quotes: **Methods** — In this international, multicentre, double-blind, randomised trial, 6 609 adults with CKD at risk of progression were allocated 1∶1 to empagliflozin 10 mg once daily or matching placebo. Key eligibility criteria were an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) between 20 and <45 mL/min/1.73 m² (any albuminuria) or between 45 and <90 mL/min/1.73 m² with a urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (ACR) of at least 200 mg/g. The primary endpoint was a composite of kidney disease progression (onset of end-stage kidney disease, a sustained eGFR below 10 mL/min/1.73 m², a sustained ≥ 40 % decline in eGFR, or renal death) or death from cardiovascular causes.
